details: The cryptocurrency market is experiencing a pullback as renewed military tensions between the U.S. and Iran, coupled with rising oil prices and higher Treasury yields, weigh on risk assets. Bitcoin has fallen towards $77,000, extending its weakness after a strong August. Ethereum, XRP, and Solana also saw declines, with the total crypto market capitalization slipping to around $2.59 trillion. This decline follows the market's failure to build on its August recovery, and investors are now monitoring if this is a short-term correction or a deeper downturn.
title: Crypto Market Pullback Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: A consortium of 21 financial institutions, including prominent names like Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Citi, and Deutsche Bank, announced plans to establish a company this year to issue a cryptocurrency pegged to the U.S. dollar in the first half of 2027. This initiative, initially announced in October 2025 with 10 banks, aims to expand into stablecoins pegged to other G7 currencies, prioritizing the Euro. This move signifies traditional finance's growing interest in leveraging blockchain for mainstream financial systems.
title: Major Banks Plan to Launch Dollar-Pegged Stablecoin by H1 2027

details: Binance is deepening its integration with traditional finance by offering physically settled options on over 1,000 U.S. equities. Eligible users can trade these contracts through Binance, with Nest routing orders and Alpaca handling execution, settlement, and custody of the shares. This development represents a significant step towards bridging the gap between the crypto and traditional financial markets, potentially increasing accessibility and adoption of crypto-related financial products.
title: Binance Expands into Traditional Finance with US Equity Options

details: The Arbitrum (ARB) token is demonstrating relative strength, driven by a sharp rally fueled by activity on Robinhood Chain. Robinhood Chain, which utilizes Arbitrum Orbit technology, generated record revenue, creating a direct economic link to the broader Arbitrum ecosystem. ARB surged by nearly 30% around the start of September, indicating strong investor interest and positive momentum for the layer-2 scaling solution.
title: Arbitrum's ARB Token Shows Strong Performance Amid Robinhood Chain Activity

details: A significant 36-day staking bottleneck is currently costing Ethereum depositors over $350,000 in lost rewards daily. This five-week activation backlog is delaying rewards for more than 2 million ETH awaiting entry into the blockchain network, highlighting a technical challenge within the Ethereum staking mechanism.
title: Ethereum Staking Bottleneck Leads to Daily Lost Rewards

details: Japan-listed company Remixpoint has announced it is selling all its holdings of Ethereum (ETH), Solana (SOL), XRP, and Dogecoin (DOGE) as it shifts to a Bitcoin-only cryptocurrency strategy. This decision indicates a strategic pivot towards focusing solely on Bitcoin, potentially reflecting a more conservative or specialized approach to digital asset investments by some institutional players.
title: Japan's Remixpoint Adopts Bitcoin-Only Crypto Strategy
